content.text:
The font file wasn't loading, which is why every page looked different. That one cause explains all 12 visual failures, and I've fixed it.

`site/css/tokens.css` pointed the `@font-face` at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the directory is `fonts/`. The browser couldn't find the file and fell back to the system font on every page. The fix changes the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't check history to see when the path broke. I found it by reading the stylesheet.

All 12 visual tests (6 pages at desktop and phone size) now match the approved screenshots, and all 16 functional tests pass. I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
